n01.heard: In my town, your head shows the last thing you said.

n02.heard: Most of the time, it's something nice.

n04.heard: I said it to my sister three weeks ago.

n05.heard: Then I stopped talking, so it stayed.

n06.heard: Since mom got sick, Ava did everything.

a02.heard: Eat your dinner, I'll be back late.

n07.heard: She never smiled. She never said anything nice.

n08.heard: Every night she left, so one night I followed her.

n09.heard: She went to the hospital, to mom.

m01.heard: She comes every night. She only ever talks about you.

n10.heard: The last thing she said was about me.

n11.heard: For three weeks, my head said I hate you.

n12.heard: It only took three words to fix it.
